reason: The initial development upper reference used per-configuration linear regression directly from input to output, which could not represent the shared nonlinear backbone plus a configuration-specific hidden/output map. It was not a valid quality upper control.
change: Replace the independent reference with an oracle-calibrated full effective output map per configuration, M_c = G(theta_c) C_c, applied after the same shared hidden backbone. Charge every serialized map. The native, Mirror, rank-one control, worlds, fit/heldout configurations and gates are unchanged.
new_development_replay: A1 development is rerun on the same two development seeds before fresh execution.
claim_boundary: This is an oracle upper storage/quality reference, not a training-reachable baseline.
